title: Add a spacer to the Dock
summary: Use dockutil to add a spacer tile to the Dock. Spacers help organize apps into groups. You can choose regular, small, or flexible spacers.

steps.explain: Adds a spacer tile to the Dock. You can specify the type (spacer, small-spacer, flex-spacer), the section (usually apps), and place it after a specific item.

placeholders.name: SPACER_TYPE
placeholders.description: Type of spacer: spacer, small-spacer, or flex-spacer

placeholders.name: SECTION
placeholders.description: The Dock section to add to, usually 'apps'

placeholders.name: DOCK_ITEM_LABEL
placeholders.description: The label of the item to place the spacer after
